calculation.description: 20-day return divided by 20-day daily return volatility. Essentially a momentum Sharpe ratio over 20d window. At the cross-asset level, this produces a strong negative IC (reversion signal): assets with strong risk-adjusted momentum tend to mean-revert over the next 10 days. Valid ICIR -7.95 places it among the most stable predictors.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2020-01..2035-12 on 15 cross-asset instruments. Covers COVID crash, inflation/rate hiking cycles, AI rally, crypto/commodity cycles, VIX stress regimes. Negative IC consistent across both halves of sample. Risk-adjusted momentum shows stronger mean-reversion than raw momentum, suggesting the vol-scaling isolates the reversion component.
